rfp1.txt.RFP Name: ERP Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review
rfp1.txt.RFP Contact (name and/or email): Indra Ghosh, Supervisor of Purchasing and Treasury. PublicBids@rockyview.ca
rfp1.txt.Submission Method / Portal: Proposals must be addressed to: Purchasing Department Rocky View County Attention: Indra Ghosh, Email: PublicBids@rockyview.ca; Proposals must be submitted in PDF and received electronically
rfp1.txt.Contract Term / Duration (including rene: shall be in effect from the date of official acceptance by the County until December 31, 2025; this agreement may be renewed under the same terms and conditions for a period of up to one (1) additional year; for a total period not to exceed three (3) years
rfp1.txt.Scope of Deliverables / Services Request: Phase 1 – Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review (Expected Completion Date: on or before December 31, 2025); Phase 2 – Development of Request for Proposal (RFP) for ERP Solution (Expected Completion Date: on or before February 02, 2026); Phase 3 – ERP Vendor Evaluation and Selection Process (Expected Completion Date: on or before May 29, 2026); Provide a “Market Intelligence Report” to the County’s project team before the RFP development process
rfp1.txt.Mandatory Submission Requirements: Proponents are instructed to complete the Submission Form set out in Appendix B of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission; Proponents are instructed to complete the Pricing Schedule as set out in Section F of Appendix D of this RFP and include it in their proposal submission; Proponents are instructed to complete and submit the Mandatory Evaluation Table below for their proposal; Any ‘No’ answers within the table will result in automatic disqualification unless the included justification satisfies the evaluation committee; All required Insurance and Documents and References: Insurance Certificate and Past references
rfp1.txt.Evaluation Criteria & Weighting (points: Proponent’s Qualifications and Experience (VALUE: 10%); Team Qualifications and Experience (VALUE: 25%); Client References and Past Experience (VALUE: 10%); Work Plan, Methodology, and Quality Assurance (VALUE: 30%); Pricing/ Professional Fees: (VALUE: 25%); Points will be awarded on a scale of 0 to 5 as noted below
rfp1.txt.Pricing Structure / Cost Submission Requ: The Proponent shall provide a TASK-FEE SCHEDULE (Unit price and Lump-sum price structure) showing the following, at a minimum; Rates must be provided in Canadian ($) funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for applicable sales taxes, which should be itemized separately; Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive; Pricing is one of five (5) criteria of the RFP that proponents will be evaluated on for which points will be awarded on a scale of 0 to 5 and will carry a weighting of 25% of the total RFP score
rfp1.txt.Required Vendor Experience / Qualificati: The Proponent’s appointed Project Manager (and back-up Project Manager) shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in having led a minimum of two (2) ERP projects from readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period; Project team members must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience on ERP-related projects, with demonstrated experience in readiness assessment through to implementation within the last seven (7) year period
rfp1.txt.Number of References Required: MINIMUM OF THREE (3) (preferably PUBLIC SECTOR) client references for whom they have provided SIMILAR/ IDENTICAL SERVICES WITHIN THE LAST SEVEN (7) YEARS
rfp1.txt.Data Security / Privacy Compliance Requi: All information provided by or obtained from the County in any form in connection with this RFP either before or after the issuance of this RFP (a) is the sole property of the County and must be treated as confidential; Security Protocols: Define the security protocols and measures necessary to safeguard sensitive information stored within the ERP system. This encompasses role-based access controls, data encryption, audit trails, and compliance with data protection regulations
rfp1.txt.Vendor Demonstration Requirement: After completion of the initial review, the 2nd level evaluation may be conducted through presentation and Interview; If required Rocky View County’s evaluation team may call all the proponents or shortlisted proponents for 2nd level interview
rfp1.txt.Summary: Rocky View County is embarking on a transformative journey to enhance operational efficiency and streamline business processes. To pursue this goal, the County is seeking proposals from experienced and qualified consultants to conduct a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Requirements Analysis and Readiness Review, followed by the development of a Request for Proposal (RFP) document (Scope of work) in collaboration with the County’s appointed project team members, and to serve as an advisor for the ERP evaluation and selection process.

rfp2.txt.Organization: Olds College of Agriculture and Technology
rfp2.txt.Submission Method / Portal: Electronic copy by email to submissions@oldscollege.ca
rfp2.txt.Contract Term / Duration (including rene: Five (5) years starting February 1, 2027, with two (2) separate three-year renewal options; maximum total term of eleven (11) years
rfp2.txt.Scope of Deliverables / Services Request: Enhance the existing Moodle LMS through improved third-party support or provide a new LMS solution; support student learning, instructor workflows, distance learning, content management, assessment, communication and engagement, mobile access, artificial intelligence, data analytics, integrations, security, data migration, implementation, and ongoing customer support
rfp2.txt.Mandatory Submission Requirements: The Proposal Certification Document in Section C Item 9 must be completed in full and signed. Proposals missing this certification will not be considered for evaluation.
rfp2.txt.Mandatory Technical Requirements: Detailed LMS requirements include accessibility, mobile learning, Ellucian Banner integration, APIs, security, HECVAT cybersecurity and privacy assessment, SAML SSO, MFA, data migration, cloud hosting, data analytics, customer support, and implementation.
rfp2.txt.Evaluation Criteria & Weighting (points: Company Experience: 15 points; Staff/Resource Experience: 5 points; Proposed Solution and Approach: 40 points; Pricing: 40 points; Reference Checks and Interview: satisfactory yes/no; Total Points Available: 100
rfp2.txt.Pricing Structure / Cost Submission Requ: Pricing must be submitted in Canadian dollars and remain fixed throughout the five-year agreement. Pricing includes one-time implementation or enhancement costs, training and data migration costs, annual software subscription and/or ongoing support costs, individual module or option pricing, and GST.
rfp2.txt.Minimum Insurance Coverage Requirements: RFP Section 5.1 requires Comprehensive General Liability insurance of not less than CAD $2,000,000 per occurrence and all-risks insurance on property of others sufficient to cover property in the Contractor's care, custody and control. The attached Services Agreement also states general liability insurance of CAD $5,000,000 per occurrence unless waived or varied by Olds College.
rfp2.txt.Required Vendor Experience / Qualificati: Experience providing LMS systems and support or support for an existing Moodle LMS; experience working with post-secondary institutions, including institutions using Ellucian Banner; relevant staff and resource experience and qualifications
rfp2.txt.Data Security / Privacy Compliance Requi: Maintain data security standards; safeguards against data breaches; comply with Alberta privacy requirements (POPA); provide a HECVAT cybersecurity and privacy assessment; support SAML-based Single Sign-On and describe MFA support
rfp2.txt.Data Hosting / Residency Requirements (w: Cloud-based LMS required; Canadian host location is preferred
rfp2.txt.Vendor Demonstration Requirement: Product demos are planned during the evaluation period from September 10 to November 15, 2026; Olds College may request presentations from shortlisted proponents
rfp2.txt.Summary: Olds College is seeking to enhance its existing Moodle LMS through improved third-party support or implement a new LMS to improve student learning, instructor support, online learning, integrations, security, analytics, implementation, and ongoing support.

rfp3.txt.Contract Term / Duration (including rene: 5 years, with the City option to extend annually for an additional 2 years
rfp3.txt.Scope of Deliverables / Services Request: A modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking for employees, volunteers, and other external learners.
rfp3.txt.Mandatory Submission Requirements: Submission Form (Appendix B): completed and signed; Pricing (Appendix C): pricing information that complies with the instructions contained in Appendix C - Pricing; Bid Security: N/A; Other Mandatory Submission Requirements: N/A.
rfp3.txt.Mandatory Technical Requirements: Refer to the Functional Requirements, Scope of Work, and the Evaluation Criteria.
rfp3.txt.Evaluation Criteria & Weighting (points: Technical Capability – 50 points; Vendor Experience & References – 15 points; Implementation & Support – 20 points; Pricing – 15 points; Product Demonstration – 30 points; Total – 130 points.
rfp3.txt.Minimum Score Threshold to Advance (wher: Minimum technical score of 35 out of 50 points.
rfp3.txt.Pricing Structure / Cost Submission Requ: Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except for GST, which should be itemized separately. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive.
rfp3.txt.Minimum Insurance Coverage Requirements: Commercial General Liability Insurance: Not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence; Professional Errors and Omissions Liability Insurance: not less than $1,000,000 per claim, with an aggregate limit of not less than $2,000,000; Cyber Liability Insurance: minimum $2,000,000 per occurrence; Automobile Liability Insurance: no less than $2,000,000 per occurrence.
rfp3.txt.Required Vendor Experience / Qualificati: Relevant LMS experience: years providing this service, implementations, Municipal/government implementations, references similar in scope & size over last 5 years, roles & responsibilities – both the implementation & support teams’ resumes that will be assigned to this project.
rfp3.txt.Data Security / Privacy Compliance Requi: Security & Privacy: Ensure data security. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit to protect against unauthorized access. Single Sign On (SSO) and/or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Secure login with single sign-on or multi-factor authentication. Vendor Cybersecurity Compliance: Compliance with industry security best practices (SOC2, ISO, etc.). PIPA Compliance: Vendor server preferred within Canada to comply with PIPA. Incident Response Plan: Vendor has an incident response plan. Business Continuity Plan: Vendor has a business continuity and disaster recovery (BCP/DR) plan. Data Retention Policy: Clear data retention policy, including post-contract data management.
rfp3.txt.Data Hosting / Residency Requirements (w: Vendor server preferred within Canada to comply with PIPA. Data Storage: Option for cloud storage in Canada or on-premises storage.
rfp3.txt.Vendor Demonstration Requirement: Stage 2 will consist of a product demonstration. Stage 2 demonstrations will be scored out of 30 points and added to the Stage 1 scores to determine the final ranking (Total = 130 points).
rfp3.txt.Summary: The City of Medicine Hat is seeking proposals for a modern, user-friendly, and secure Corporate Learning Management System (LMS) to support corporate training, onboarding, compliance, safety, professional development, and certification tracking. The LMS will streamline end-to-end content delivery, automate assignments and reminders, standardize reporting, and integrate with the City’s existing identity, collaboration, and human resources systems.

rfp4.txt.Submission Method / Portal: BCBid platform where the RFP is posted. No physical submission will be accepted unless specifically requested.
rfp4.txt.Contract Term / Duration (including rene: The contract will involve two parts. The first part will be for the implementation of the ERP and the second part will be for the licensing. The term of the licensing and support agreement is to be for a period of five years, with an option in favour of Cowichan Tribes to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions.
rfp4.txt.Scope of Deliverables / Services Request: Cowichan Tribes is seeking to procure a cloud-based ERP system(s) to enhance operational efficiency across key functions including finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management. The solution should be aligned with industry best practice, provide features to automate processes, provide staff and leadership access to the information needed to effectively plan and operate, and be adaptable to evolving business needs.
rfp4.txt.Mandatory Submission Requirements: The Proposal must be received by the Submission Deadline and must be submitted using the submission method; the Proposal must be in English; a completed Submission Form in PDF format signed by an authorized representative; a completed Narrative Response in PDF format; a completed Pricing Excel Workbook; a completed Requirements Excel Workbook.
rfp4.txt.Mandatory Technical Requirements: Support for organizations operating in Canada including support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll; Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada; the solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada; implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions; Solution is cloud based; the solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.
rfp4.txt.Evaluation Criteria & Weighting (points: Functional Fit (Requirements Worksheet) – 35 points; Narrative Proposal – 20 points; Pricing – 15 points; Vendor Demonstration – 30 points; Total Points – 100.
rfp4.txt.Minimum Score Threshold to Advance (wher: Functional Fit: 28 (80%); Narrative Proposal: 14 (70%); Pricing: 10.5 (70%); Vendor Demonstration: 21 (70%).
rfp4.txt.Pricing Structure / Cost Submission Requ: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a pricing formula using the rates set out in the Proponent’s submitted Pricing Sheet. Pricing includes details for implementing and supporting the solution over a 5-year period. Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes. Rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive.
rfp4.txt.Required Vendor Experience / Qualificati: Vendor has experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada; implementation vendor(s) can demonstrate they have at least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions.
rfp4.txt.Number of References Required: At least two and at most five references for implementations involving the proposed solutions in Canada. Preference is for references to First Nation clients.
rfp4.txt.Data Security / Privacy Compliance Requi: Platform and Operational Security: Provide a description of how the proposed systems meet or exceed industry security standards and how the Proponent addresses on-going and emerging privacy and cybersecurity risks. Provide a list of third-party vendors who support cybersecurity practices within the organization. The solutions are SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.
rfp4.txt.Data Hosting / Residency Requirements (w: The solution must be hosted in Canada and stores all data within Canada.
rfp4.txt.Vendor Demonstration Requirement: Vendors selected for the demonstration stage will be required to present their proposed solutions in accordance with the demo script that will be provided by Cowichan Tribes. The script will outline the key functionalities and scenarios that must be addressed during the demonstration.
rfp4.txt.Summary: Cowichan Tribes is seeking to procure a cloud-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system to enhance operational efficiency across finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management.

rfp5.txt.Contract Term / Duration (including rene: 5 years; one 3-year extension; one 2-year extension; maximum 10 years
rfp5.txt.Scope of Deliverables / Services Request: AI Chat and Data Analysis Services; AI Model Customization and Integration; AI Consulting Services; AI Enabling Infrastructure
rfp5.txt.Mandatory Submission Requirements: Completed Appendix A; Completed Appendix D; Completed HECVAT or SaaS Vendor Form; Minimum 3 references; Authorized signed proposal
rfp5.txt.Mandatory Technical Requirements: Privacy and intellectual property compliance; Infrastructure protection; Security and data protection; Integration and user Management
rfp5.txt.Evaluation Criteria & Weighting (points: Technical & AI Platform Services: 30; Optional Services: 5; Professional Services: 5; Proponent Qualifications: 10; Support & Management: 10; Cost: 30; University Benefit & Sustainability: 5; Indigenous Participation: 5
rfp5.txt.Pricing Structure / Cost Submission Requ: GST/PST excluded; DDP Incoterms 2010 USask; firm for 5 years
rfp5.txt.Minimum Insurance Coverage Requirements: Commercial General Liability: $5,000,000 CAD; Cybersecurity Liability: $5,000,000 CAD
rfp5.txt.Required Vendor Experience / Qualificati: Demonstrated corporate structure and ownership; Willingness to accommodate USask requirements and accept preferred contractual provisions; Demonstrated ability to work in a large university environment or an organization of similar complexity; Relevant experience, competence, and reliability in handling similar projects
rfp5.txt.Data Security / Privacy Compliance Requi: Copyright Act; Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA); Local Authority Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (LA FOIP); Health Information Protection Act (HIPA); Encryption; Security audits; Higher Education Community Vendor Assessment Toolkit (HECVAT) or USask SaaS Form
rfp5.txt.Summary: University of Saskatchewan RFP to establish multiple master service agreements with pre-qualified suppliers for Generative AI platform, customization, integration, consulting, and enabling infrastructure services
